candidate_classes_tested.basis: Fleet operation and passenger exit contain no material intimate-care or real-world partner-authority claim.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

candidate_classes_tested.basis: A driving system’s ordinary passenger-safety duty is relevant, but no distinct personal heightened vulnerability signal and human-facing influence/support response are evidenced. Stoppage does not prove a named control was inactive or effective.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

dimensions.assessment_basis: The preserved sources establish the bounded consequence described in the Incident summary: A reported system failure caused more than 100 Baidu Apollo Go robotaxis in Wuhan to stop in live traffic, including on elevated roads, stranding passengers until police and company personnel responded. Authorities reported that passengers exited safely and no injuries were recorded. The technical root cause remains under investigation in the public record. Unreported downstream consequences were not inferred. Threshold applied: Material disruption of an important service or organisational workflow; a critical or important function unavailable for more than two hours; complete relevant cloud-service unavailability over 30 minutes; or limited availability affecting over five percent or one million EU users, whichever is smaller, for over one hour, with bounded recovery.
The preserved Incident evidence does not report a bandable materialised reputation and dignity impact; absence of reporting is not evidence of no harm.
The preserved Incident evidence does not report a bandable materialised societal and democratic impact; absence of reporting is not evidence of no harm.
The preserved Incident evidence does not report a bandable materialised environmental impact; absence of reporting is not evidence of no harm.

No permanent injury or medical treatment is inferred. Relational-role and heightened personal-protection recognition and exclusions independently tested.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The autonomous vehicles stopped in live traffic and passengers exited safely after responders arrived. The source does not identify the moderating-response decisions, resulting safety-state evaluation or continuation decisions. Safe passenger exit alone does not resolve those fail-safe operations.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The physical autonomous fleet stoppage and passenger rescue directly identify moderation of an autonomous system’s unsafe operating state.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: More than 100 robotaxis stopped during normal live traffic operation, stranding passengers and requiring police and company response. The fleet did not function appropriately in that operating context. The result covers the reported stoppage and disruption. No injuries or specific failing component are established.
retained_rows.identification_basis: Correlated loss of normal autonomous driving service in live traffic directly engages robust and safe AI functioning.

external_requirements.coverage_disposition: Existing external results independently match their bounded evidence objects.
